caption: Mapping the window centre (5, 2.5) to the viewport centre (100, 50): subtract the window minimum, scale by 20, add the viewport minimum. The scale 20 is the viewport width 200 divided by the window width 10.

spec.title: Window to viewport mapping
spec.aria: A left-to-right flow diagram showing the mapping of world point (5,2.5) to device point (100,50) by subtracting the window minimum (0,0), multiplying by scale 20, and adding the viewport minimum (0,0).
